verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਜਾਤ ਰਾਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਿਆਗਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: raag jaat raagee jaanai bairaagai bairaagee jaanai tiaageh tiaagee jaanai dheen dhiaa dhaan hai ||

en.bdb: A musician alone knows the modes of music and singing and their various forms. Only a renunciator who has given up his attachment with worldly goods know what a detached temperament is, a hermit alone knows what it involves and a donor would know what it is to be kind to a poor.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਰੋਗ ਦੋਖ ਰੋਗੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਬਖਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jog jugat jogee jaanai bhog ras bhogee jaanai rog dhokh rogee jaanai pragaT bakhaan hai ||

en.bdb: Similarly a Yogi knows the method of strenuous penances that are required to be practiced for realisation of God. A relisher would know how to enjoy the taste and enjoyment of worldly tastes and this can be emphatically stated that a patient alone knows the pain of another patient.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫੂਲ ਰਾਖ ਮਾਲੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਨਹਿ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਸਕਲ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਗਤਿ ਗਾਂਧੀ ਜਾਨਉ ਜਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: fool raakh maalee jaanai paaneh ta(n)bolee jaanai sakal suga(n)dh gat gaa(n)dhee jaanau jaan hai ||

en.bdb: A gardener knows how to take care of flowers, a betel leaf seller alone knows how to preserve betel leaves. One can learn the secret of scents from a perfume seller.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੈ ਜਉਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਿਹਾਰੈ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਨੈ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਪਹਿਚਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੬੭੫॥
verses.translit_en: ratanai jauhaaree jaanai bihaarai biauhaaree jaanai aatam preekhiaa kouoo bibekee pahichaan hai ||675||

en.bdb: Only a jeweller knows how to evaluate and examine the genuineness of a jewel. A trader knows all aspects of business but he who can recognise the reality of spiritual virtues is a rare, wise and knowledgeable person who has imbibed the teachings of Guru in his mind .  (675)
